entries.020f5b98463c81c8: Centered on the department store business, and with the management philosophy of 'creating vitality as a regional hub for exchange and contributing to improving the living culture of customers in its market,' the company states that in the Ishikawa and Toyama area it will respond to regional customers' expectations through a product lineup and attractive sales planning that only the company can offer, and that it will promote a review of its expense structure and business efficiency to strengthen its earnings base. In the medium to long term, the company states that it will work to strengthen the development of 'new products and planning,' hold culturally rich art events, develop authentic-quality products for regional product fairs, and promote community-based sales through expanded initiatives with leading regional companies and producers; and that its group companies aim to establish 'independent management.'

entries.778300bba7bd412d: Founded as a department store in Katamachi, Kanazawa City, in 1923, the company has its head office in Kanazawa City, Ishikawa Prefecture. Together with seven consolidated subsidiaries and one equity-method affiliate, it forms a corporate group; the consolidated number of employees as of February 28, 2026 was 694.
entries.779620001cb3c7f6: Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥15,983 million. By business, the department store business was ¥13,445 million, the hotel business ¥1,152 million, the publishing business ¥764 million, the printing business ¥211 million, the staffing services business ¥63 million, and other ¥345 million. Revenue for the previous fiscal year was ¥16,434 million.

entries.944e179bbb751fb9: Since its founding in 1923, the company has been based in Katamachi, Kanazawa City, and has a regionally rooted sales base, operating department stores in Ishikawa and Toyama Prefectures. Its strengths are a base of regular customers built through the operation of the Tomonokai, as well as food and local product events held at both stores and the development of products and planning that only the company can offer in the region.
entries.9f3442d65c82bd55: It operates two department stores, the Kōrinbō store in Kanazawa City and the Toyama store in Toyama City, while its consolidated subsidiaries conduct businesses including hotels, publishing, printing, staffing services and food and beverage. For the department stores, the operation of the Tomonokai is carried out by a consolidated subsidiary.
